title: Shoot for the 10
principle: Every round, aim for a perfect 10 — don't do 'a little better' three times, do your best work three times.

source.context: Refining the Builder-Scorer Loop: mindset, not just process.

evidence.note: 'If you aim for perfect every round, you get excellence.'

applicability.situations: Every build round and every fix round.
applicability.decisions: How much effort a round deserves; whether 'good enough' is acceptable.

status_history.note: Seed migration from AGENTS.md standing laws, 2026-10-11.

graduation.next_step: Stays in briefing — mindset is enforced by honest scorecards, not code.
